name: Hover.dev
summary: Freemium React+Tailwind animated components; free-marked comps only (Pro excluded).
license: Hover Dev, LLC non-exclusive license (free-marked components; see https://www.hover.dev/license)

install.command: Open free component on hover.dev → VIEW CODE → copy JSX (no Pro)

gaps: Pilot includes 12 free-marked components of a larger freemium library — not a full inventory.
Freemium: free-marked comps need no signup; Hover Pro is $49 forever (was $149) for all comps/templates — Pro excluded; no paid unlock.
No public GitHub LICENSE/SPDX — license string taken from https://www.hover.dev/license (Hover Dev, LLC non-exclusive; free-marked only).
No shadcn registry; install is copy-paste via VIEW CODE on category pages.
iframe demos use category pages (e.g. /components/buttons) — multiple free demos share one URL.
Code extracted from public free JS bundles / VIEW CODE payloads for free-marked comps only.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
